io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.access: Discover current operations and schemas using tools/list. Private account operations require OAuth and user consent. Availability and presentation vary by host; registry publication is not platform approval. Optional AI features and imports can have limits or credit costs, disclosed in the relevant flow.

appFeatures.description: The phone apps also provide Cook mode, Pantry Check, Make me a recipe, Recreate a meal from a photo and Fix my recipes. Some Chef IQ features are labelled experimental and use credits. These app features are not all exposed as MCP tools; consult the live tool inventory.

capabilities: Discover recipes by ingredients, cooking time and food preferences.
Draft a weekly dinner plan, choose alternatives and adjust servings.
Save and reuse meal plans as Saved Weeks; explicitly activate This Week.
Read and update pantry stock, including fridge and freezer locations.
Build and update combined shopping lists with pantry-aware planning.
Save recipes to a personal library and import recipes from URLs or images.
Review proposed recipe edits or adaptations before applying confirmed changes.
Share a saved week or import a shared week with the user’s agreement.
Open a shopping review and supermarket search handoff; no checkout or purchase.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description: Chop it connects recipe discovery and organisation, weekly meal planning, pantry inventory and shopping lists in one account. Find dinners around ingredients you already have, cooking time, servings and food preferences. Save recipes, import from a URL or image, reuse Saved Weeks, review This Week and prepare the weekly shop. Use the iPhone or Android app alongside connected assistants. Public recipe search and draft planning are available without an account; personal records and saved changes require account connection and consent.
exampleRequests: What can I cook with the ingredients in my pantry?
Help me plan five dinners for two people this week.
Import this recipe into my recipe library.
Make a shopping list for my chosen dinners, accounting for my pantry.
Show my saved weeks so I can choose one to reuse.

otherServices.brandedApps: Separate branded recipe and meal-planning app service for food businesses. See the businessApps link; this is not an MCP app-creation tool.
